UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: User login credential and profile for multi-device cross-browser synchronization

username.description: Unique username used for login across devices

passwordHash.description: SHA-256 salted password hash for secure authentication

email.description: Registered email address for account and password recovery

recoveryCode.description: Temporary 6-digit recovery code for password reset

recoveryExpires.description: ISO timestamp when the recovery code expires

name.description: Display name of the user or advocate

honorific.description: User title e.g. Mr., Ms., Barrister, Advocate

RecoveryRecord.title: RecoveryRecord
RecoveryRecord.description: Email-to-username index and recovery code storage

username.description: Username associated with this email address

UserCase.title: UserCase
UserCase.description: Individual court case stored under a user account

id.description: Unique ID of the court case

username.description: Owner username of this court case record

court.description: Court forum e.g. KPST or PHC

caseTitle.description: Title of the case / Parties involved

bench.description: Tribunal Bench e.g. SB Zia ul Haq, DB-I

advocateName.description: Name of the practicing advocate or counsel

natureOfCase.description: Nature of case matter e.g. Promotion, Seniority, Pension

decision.description: Status or decision of the case

causeListSrNo.description: Serial number in the published cause list

causeListBench.description: Bench description from published cause list

/accounts/{username}.description: User account credentials and profile indexed by unique username

/recovery_emails/{email}.description: Email-to-username index and recovery code storage

/accounts/{username}/cases/{caseId}.description: All court cases tracked by the specified username
